title: Eiffel Tower director faces turmoil after sidelining of female staff at request of Hindu delegation
subhead: The exclusion of female staff members during a visit by members of an ultra-conservative Hindu religious group, sparked a strike and two investigations. Above all, the incident exposed the underlying unease within the company that runs the Iron Lady: contested management, social tensions and a lack of effective political oversight.

title: Vladimir Putin, a president sealed off in a Russia under lockdown
subhead: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites. Within society, they have spread an atmosphere of fear and suspicion that prohibits any questioning of the Kremlin or its war in Ukraine.

title: Poll: Le Pen begins presidential campaign in strongest position ever amid worried, angry electorate
subhead: In France's polarized political landscape, Marine Le Pen of the far-right Rassemblement National is enjoying unprecedented support, and radical left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon is building a strong base. Wide open for other candidates, the race is drawing significant interest from voters concerned about the future, Le Monde's first poll shows.
